rca_of_the_issue: The ui-portal Button was implemented as a straight port of an Expo React Native Button that used `testID` (RN-standard). On web the CI/acceptance tests expect `data-testid` (web-standard). The port destructured only the known props from the RN component and did not spread `...rest`, so any `data-testid` passed by callers landed nowhere. Result: many acceptance selectors like `[data-testid="asap-submit"]` returned zero matches even though the button was clearly rendered. Fix accepts BOTH `testID` and `data-testid` (giving precedence to the web-standard) and spreads remaining props so callers can pass aria-label, role, etc. without a code change per callsite.
